scope: Public DataFrame adapter grouping and generated output schema; no native adapter claim
findings: For the 72 observed cases, sorted unique case labels select contiguous positional slices from their first occurrence with length equal to their frequency.
This differs from gather-by-case grouping for interleaved inputs; frame index labels did not alter the observed behavior.
Returned frames regenerate case IDs, timestamps, three standard columns and a fresh index; extra columns and frame attrs were dropped in the observed cases.
limits: Finite public behavior evidence; no native implementation or coverage status promotion.
Custom selectors, dtype variants, missing values and generated metadata need broader evidence before adapter completion.
